# SDX with SMH

> Personal website of Hossein Mayboudi, a senior backend engineer in Tehran, Iran, focused on backend systems, distributed services, trading platforms, and reliable APIs.

The site provides an overview of software development services, engineering experience, technical skills, education, and contact information.

- [Home](https://sdxwithsmh.ir/): Software development services and an overview of the site's focus.
- [About Hossein Mayboudi](https://sdxwithsmh.ir/about-me.html): Professional experience, background, skills, and contact details.
